svg.title: Every run is a log. Everything else is read from it.
svg.desc: A thread's append-only log of events: thread_started, user_input, model_request, model_response, tool_call, permission_decision, tool_result, model_request, model_response, turn_completed. Four things are read back from it: replay with timeline(), resume by running the thread again, fork from a past step, and evals with saveCase().
svg.text: Every run is a log. Everything else is read from it.
Every step, and the exact request the model saw
Continues after a crash. Unsure side effects park.
A new branch from a past step, in its own sandbox
A real turn becomes a regression case on disk
State is computed from the log. Nothing is kept on the side.
